description: Source code for an AI client library in Go, providing functionalities to perform chat completions, including streaming responses, using OpenAI or OpenRouter APIs.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: A client for interacting with AI/LLM APIs, supporting chat completions and streaming responses.

classes.name: SSEDecoder
classes.description: Decoder for Server-Sent Events stream, used to parse streaming responses from the API.

methods.name: NewClient
methods.description: Creates a new AI client with the specified configuration.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Performs a chat completion request with a prompt.

methods.name: CompleteWithMessages
methods.description: Performs a chat completion request with custom messages.

methods.name: StreamComplete
methods.description: Performs a streaming chat completion request, returning a channel of response chunks.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes the next SSE stream chunk from the response.

methods.name: SimpleAI
methods.description: Performs a simple AI call with a prompt, returning the generated text.

methods.name: StructuredAI
methods.description: Performs an AI call and unmarshals the response into a structured data format.
